title: Nexus CoreActorContext
description: Serializable owned projection of an admitted Actor: validated Creator ownership, active World/binding/branch/event anchors and the stored Character lifecycle epoch at admission. Grants no authority.

owner_creator_id.description: Trusted owner admitted at request time; never taken from a later request body.

binding_id.description: Active ActorWorldBinding id; null for Creator actors.

branch_id.description: Fork branch anchor (fbk_*); null when the session has no branch isolation.

event_id.description: Timeline event rewind anchor; null when absent.

character_epoch.description: Stored Character lifecycle_epoch at admission; null for Creator actors. Mismatch after admission is actor_session_stale.
